messages:
Priya S: Kicking off onboarding for Tanager — they signed up for a 2-week pilot, focus on embeddings + chat, and want a Dedicated slot if perf looks good.
Eli (CS): Thanks — quick ask: who from their side will be the day-to-day?
Marta (Tanager): Hi all, I'm product lead for this. Liam will own infra/network. We can commit a sandbox dataset (10k docs) and two SREs for connectivity.
Priya S: Perfect. High-level success criteria proposal: 1) ingest 10k docs, 2) p95 latency < 500ms for chat on short queries, 3) embedding recall >= our baseline on their eval set, 4) no more than 5% error rate on calls. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jun (Solutions): Those look reasonable. Add: tie acceptance to a short end-user spot-check (3 scenarios) so we capture qualitative feedback.
Liam (Tanager Infra): FYI we need private VPC peering and IP allowlist. ETA: we can get networking ready day 4 if we get the CIDR and certs.
Ben (Eng): I'll spin up a test Dedicated profile and provide model/quantization recommendations by EOD tomorrow.
Priya S: Timeline idea: Day 0-1 discovery + creds; Day 2-4 infra + peering; Day 5-7 ingest & index; Day 8-10 eval + user spot-check; Day 11-14 iterate + go/no-go. Can we commit to that?
Marta (Tanager): Sounds good. Can you add a clear rollback plan if accuracy regresses? We can't risk bad responses in front of users.
Eli (CS): We'll include rollback: automatic fallback to a smaller-capacity hosted variant + circuit-breaker after X errors. Also schedule a canary with 5% traffic before full cutover.
Onboarding Bot: New onboarding doc created: https://redwood.company/onboard/tanager-pilot (permissions: team-only) :page_with_curl:
Priya S: Action items (owner): 1) Networking info from Tanager (Liam) — due day 1. 2) Dedicated test profile + perf guidance (Ben) — due day 2. 3) Ingest script + sample mapping (Jun) — due day 4. 4) Eval prompt set + spot-check rubric (Eli + Marta) — due day 7.
Liam (Tanager Infra): I'll drop CIDR + certs here by EOD.
Ben (Eng): Drafted perf settings, posting quickstart snippet below:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/deploy \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-mini-embed","quant":"q4_0","batch_size":8}'
```
Priya S: Great — Jun, can you confirm ingestion format?
Jun (Solutions): We'll accept JSONL with fields: id, text, metadata. I'll upload an example to the doc.
Marta (Tanager): One more ask — can we include a simple cost estimate for Dedicated for the pilot? We need that for procurement.
Ben (Eng): I'll attach a cost calc in the doc (rough hourly + projected tokens).
Eli (CS): Risk flags: renewal risk if the pilot shows instability or accuracy misses >2 buckets. We should proactively schedule a mid-pilot check-in (Day 8) with execs.
Priya S: Noted. I'll book a Day 8 check-in now.
Liam (Tanager Infra): Confirmed networking posted.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: Day 8 check-in (calendar invite sent to participants).
Priya S: Thanks everyone — I'll update the onboarding doc with action owners + deadlines. Ping here for blockers. :raised_hands:
